**Location:** This file lives in **`aol_site/`** with the transparency portal. **Rendered HTML:** [`rubric_change_log.html`](rubric_change_log.html) (open via the same local server as other demo pages).

**How to update:** Edit this `.Rmd` (append new entries under *Change log*). Rebuild the HTML from the repo root:

```bash
Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("aol_site/rubric_change_log.Rmd")'
```

**Record retention:** Prior **Word** masters and PDFs remain in [`../rubrics/`](../rubrics/) (do not delete; add new filenames when superseding). **Web** 5-point drafts remain under `aol_site/` (e.g. `rubric_template_demo.html`, `data/rubric_definitions.json`) — preserve history via git and/or dated copies as needed.

## Stable decisions (committee alignment)

These are **current working assumptions** until superseded by a dated entry below.

| Topic | Decision |
|-------|------------|
| Scale length | **5-point** competence scale (retained). |
| Program goal | **≥90%** of students at **Proficient (3) or higher** per criterion (i.e. the actionable threshold is between **2** and **3**). |
| Legacy artifacts | Keep **existing Word rubrics** and **current web 5-point drafts** for record-keeping; new versions add **new files** or clearly versioned names — do not overwrite history without archiving. |

## Change log (newest first)

### 2026-03-25 — BARS expanded to all web rubric types

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Change** | **`dimensions[].anchors`** (five behavioral sentences per criterion) added for **written_communication**, **ethics**, **critical_thinking**, **technology**, **graphics_presentation**, **collaboration**, **functional_integration**, and **diversity** in `aol_site/data/rubric_definitions.json` (oral already had anchors). |
| **Status** | Draft for SME/UPIC review; regenerate embed after edits: `python3 aol_site/scripts/sync_rubric_definitions_embed.py`. |

### 2026-03-25 — Program goal threshold: Proficient (3)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Decision** | **≥90%** of students at **Proficient (3) or higher** per criterion (green highlight and help text on web rubrics point to level **3**). |
| **Rationale** | Aligns the stated goal with **behaviorally anchored** expectations: the actionable standard is **competent/independent** work on standard tasks, not only foundational performance. |
| **Files** | `aol_site/js/rubric_template.js` (goal copy + highlight row), `oral_communication_rubric_demo.html`, this log, `docs/Rubric_Web_Template.md`. |

### 2025-03-25 — Behaviorally anchored rating scale (UPIC request)

| Field | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Requested by** | **Dr. J Robert Field** (UPIC) |
| **Request** | Define a **behaviorally anchored rating scale** that links each of the **five Likert / competence levels** to **specific behavioral criteria** relevant to **each outcome**, so a rater can **defend** the score assigned to a student. |
| **Committee context** | Committee **affirms** the **5-point** scale and the **90% goal** at **≥3 (Proficient)**; work needed on **per-outcome behavioral anchors**, not on replacing the scale. |
| **Owner / implementation** | *Assign:* primary rubric **owner** (e.g. AOL lead + outcome sponsor) and **UPIC** liaison for sign-off. |
| **Status** | **Open** — design / documentation in progress. |
| **Artifacts to produce** | Updated rubric text (Word/PDF as required), web mirror as needed, SME review notes. |
| **Links** | [`rubrics.html`](rubrics.html) · [`rubric_template_demo.html`](rubric_template_demo.html) · repo [`../rubrics/`](../rubrics/) |
